chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Qasim narrated from Safwan, from Abdullah ibn Muskhan, from Ayub ibn al-Hurr, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the children: from where do we separate them? He said, 'My father used to separate them in a trap (pit).'.
ai.seo_question: How were young children ritually purified according to the Prophet's practice?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ritual purification (*tajrid*) of young children who have not yet reached the age of religious accountability (*mukallaf*). Imam al-Sadiq (AS) reports that his father, Imam al-Baqir (AS), would perform this by placing them in a pit (*fakh*), a method likely referring to a specific form of ablution or immersion distinct from adult practices, highlighting the practical application of ritual purity for minors in Shia jurisprudence.
